## What's new in v8

- Requires [Actions Runner v2.327.1](https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/tag/v2.327.1) or later if you are using a self-hosted runner for Node 24 support.

## What's Changed
* chore: Update checkout action version to v6 by @yonas in https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/pull/4258
* Update actions/checkout references to @v6 in docs by @Copilot in https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/pull/4259
* feat: v8 by @peter-evans in https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/pull/4260

## New Contributors
* @yonas made their first contribution in https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/pull/4258
* @Copilot made their first contribution in https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/pull/4259

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/peter-evans/create-pull-request/compare/v7.0.11...v8.0.0
